# Data Preparation Overview

Welcome to the Data Preparation section! Here, you can find various guides and resources to help you with the preparation of data for Species Distribution Models (SDM).

## Available Guides

Below is a list of specific topics related to data preparation. Click on each link to access more detailed guides.

### 1. Environmental Data Preparation

[Environmental Data Preparation](data_prep/raster_preparation.qmd)\
This guide will help you prepare environmental variables such as bioclimatic data, land use, and others required for SDM.

### 2. Imbalanced dataset Part 1 and 2

[Imbalanced dataset Part 1 and 2](data_prep/imbalanced_data.qmd)\
Learn how to deal with the issue of imbalanced dataset.

### 3. Getting Shorebird Data in Australia Using Global Biodiversity Data Portals via `spocc` R Package

[Getting Shorebird Data in Australia Using Global Biodiversity Data Portals via \`spocc\` R Package](data_prep/Get_Species_data_from_multiple_sources.qmd)\
How to get speceis data from different biodiversity data portals using spocc r package.
